moat_source: flight heritage and vertical integration (50+ successful Electron launches, launch + spacecraft systems under one roof); evidence: 38.2% GAAP gross margin and $2.2B backlog, but SpaceX and emerging entrants cap pricing power

returns.assumption_note: Convergence to scenario IV by year 5, ~60% of the gap closed by year 3.

sensitivity_key_driver: year-5 FCF margin (whether positive free cash flow emerges at all)
primary_model_risk: FCF emergence: the company has no demonstrated free cash flow; base case assumes ~15% FCF margin materializes on ~$3.5B revenue by 2030. If margins emerge later or lower, even the bear case is generous. No DCF input is anchored to a reported FCF figure.
expectations_gap_key_variable: free cash flow: at $87.38 the price requires roughly 10x the base-case year-5 FCF, i.e. it capitalizes Neutron success, share gains AND SpaceX-class economics simultaneously; our base case only credits solid execution
top_5_bull_arguments: Record Q1 2026: $200.3M revenue +63.5% y/y with 38.2% GAAP gross margin - real operating leverage emerging
$2.2B backlog plus the largest contract in company history (Neutron + Electron through 2029) gives multi-year revenue visibility
Space Systems now ~2/3 of revenue - diversified beyond launch into higher-margin satellite components and platforms
US defense flow ($190M Anduril hypersonic program) positions RKLB as the credible non-SpaceX national-security launch provider
Neutron success in 2026 would open the medium-lift market and could re-rate the story entirely
top_5_bear_arguments: A 10% discount-rate DCF on any defensible FCF path yields ~$18 expected IV vs $87.38 price - the gap is not a rounding error, it is the thesis
No demonstrated free cash flow; every DCF input on the cash side is an assumption, not a datum
Neutron slip or failure is binary risk into a stock priced for flawless execution (beta 3.12)
SpaceX IPO could vacuum up the sector's speculative capital
Two simultaneous acquisition integrations (Mynaric, Motiv) during the most operationally demanding year in company history
thesis_breakers: Neutron debut failure or slip beyond 2026
Backlog shrinking sequentially for two consecutive quarters
A capital raise materially dilutive at depressed prices (funding gap signal)
Loss of a major defense program to a competitor
position_size_recommendation: 0% at current price (story admired, price refused; DCF-based buy zone is far below market and would only be actionable after a major derating or after FCF becomes observable)
notes_on_nulls: ROIC/ROE/ROA null: no sourced balance-sheet or income-statement ratios in pass1/claude_pass1 (company is pre-profit; no P/E exists). DCF is explicitly degraded: no reported FCF exists, so scenario cash flows are constructed from sourced revenue ($200.3M Q1 2026, $2.2B backlog) plus assumed margin emergence - hence confidence_level low and the avoid verdict leans on valuation asymmetry rather than model precision.
historical_context: Directional context only - low confidence. No verified historical multiple range captured. Verified datapoints only: +34% single-day move after Q1 2026 earnings (CNBC), +24.02% past week, 52-week range $22.85-$117 region per quote aggregates (pass1).
